text:
The PTAT core runs out of headroom. At 27 C, d2 = e2 + I·R1 + Vgs2 ≈ 1.42 V, which leaves M4 only 0.38 V. At −40 C, Veb rises by about 0.13 V and Vgs_n by about 0.06 V, so M4 and M1 approach the edge of saturation.

When M4 leaves saturation the current mirror breaks. The core current then tracks VDD and temperature. That would explain the 0.86 V/V line regulation and the 2886 ppm/C TC; the program now estimates the margin but still cannot model the collapse itself. The sensitivity to gmid_n (+10% gives −84% TC and −98% line regulation) supports this.

**Changes:**
- Larger BJT area (mQ = 8) to lower Veb.
- Lower Vgs on the core NMOS (higher gm/Id).
- An analytic headroom check at −40 C, with penalties added to the predicted TC and line regulation.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Cold-corner headroom collapse at d2 (Veb+IR1+Vgs_n stack under PMOS mirror) breaks mirror -> huge TC/line. Lower Veb (mQ=8), push NMOS into weak inversion (gm/Id 25) and add headroom-aware predictions."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (2.0e-6, 1.0e-6, 5e-6),
    "k_r2":   (10.0, 8.0, 12.5),
    "gmid_n": (25, 18, 28),
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (16, 10, 20),
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "gmid_7": (8.0, 4.0, 12.0),
    "L7":     (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    mQ = 8
    I = p["I"]
    dvbe = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dvbe / I
    R2 = p["k_r2"] * R1

    def veb(i, m, dT=0.0):
        v27 = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 * m / i)
        return v27 - 1.9e-3 * dT

    ve1 = veb(I, mQ)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.2, vsb=ve1)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.4)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_7"], p["L7"], I, vds=0.7, vsb=0.0)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "d2", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=mQ)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "d2", "a", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "a", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N * mQ)
    n.dev("M7", "pg", "n1", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M6", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)
    n.C("Cn1", "n1", "vss", 0.5e-12)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=mQ)
    n.M("MSP", "sx", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    vref = ve1 + p["k_r2"] * dvbe
    itot = 4 * I + 0.6e-6

    # Headroom check at worst corner (-40C, VDD-10%): d2 stack under PMOS mirror
    vgs_n = mn.vgs if hasattr(mn, "vgs") else 0.75
    vdsat_p = 2.0 / p["gmid_p"]
    d2_cold = veb(I, N * mQ, -67) + dvbe * 0.78 + vgs_n + 0.06
    margin = (VDD * 0.9 - vdsat_p - 0.1) - d2_cold
    # M1 Vds at cold: n1 = Vgs7 (rises ~0.07 V cold) minus e1
    vgs7 = m7.vgs if hasattr(m7, "vgs") else 0.85
    m1_margin = (vgs7 + 0.07) - veb(I, mQ, -67) - 0.1
    pen = 0.0
    for mg in (margin, m1_margin):
        if mg < 0.05:
            pen += (0.05 - mg) * 20.0

    A1 = mn.gm / max(mn.gds + mp.gds, 1e-15)
    A2 = m7.gm / max(mp.gm, 1e-15)
    loop = max(A1 * A2, 1.0)
    eps = (mp.gds / max(mp.gm, 1e-12)) * p["gmid_p"]
    line = p["k_r2"] * UT * eps / loop + (vref - ve1) * eps * 0.1 + 1e-3 + pen * 0.5
    # TC: residual curvature + mismatch of PTAT slope vs CTAT slope
    ctat = -(1.2 - ve1 + 3 * UT) / 300.15
    ptat = p["k_r2"] * dvbe / 300.15
    tc = abs(ctat + ptat) / vref * 1e6 + 12.0 + pen * 1000
    return n, {
        "vref": vref,
        "tc_ppm": tc,
        "power": itot * VDD,
        "line_reg": line,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
